payload.goal: A drawn tutorial machine (se.machine-tutorial) in the ledger that demonstrates every feature the machine system supports - all six edge roles, guard loops, engine-fill, gate, terminals, nesting, the iteration socket, groups - annotated with canvas comments; the compiler learns that text nodes are comments.
payload.load_bearing_for: A stranger (or the owner months later) has no single place that shows what the machine language can express; features get rediscovered by reading the compiler. Also: canvases could not carry annotations - the compiler refused text nodes, blocking self-documenting drawings.
payload.exit_check: compileMachine(se.machine-tutorial) succeeds and the compiled machine exercises: >=1 edge of every role, a guarded fallback loop, an engine-filled state with command, a gate, >=2 terminals, a nested machine reference, a submachine: iteration socket, a group; canvas text-node comments present and skipped by the compiler (test); verify green.
